LanguageData.LP_Oozefolk.label: oozefolk
LanguageData.LP_Oozefolk.description: A mass of protoplasm that gained a mind and roughly shaped itself into a person. Oozefolk have no bones; blunt weapons hit them like hitting a barrel of glue, and acid barely hurts them; wounds don't get infected or scar. They can digest anything, can engulf a whole corpse, and use stored protoplasm to split off new selves, seep through door cracks and regrow severed fingers. The price is fearing the cold (the body congeals below zero), fire and drying out. The bloodline is passed on to children; or rather, the children split off are almost identical to the parent.
LanguageData.LP_Oozefolk.descriptionShort: Inheritable. Greatly reduced blunt and acid damage, no infections, no scars, eats anything; protoplasm drives engulf, fission, seeping and reshaping; fears cold and fire.
